closed_predecessors.claim: 对任意实数 a，都有 sqrt(a^2)=|a|。
closed_predecessors.text: 因为 |a|≥0 且 |a|^2=a^2，而 sqrt(a^2) 是 a^2 的唯一非负平方根，所以 sqrt(a^2)=|a|。

Use uncertainty when evidence is insufficient. Missing counterexamples are not proofs. Independently adjudicate the preliminary diagnosis of target. quote must copy ONE contiguous substring verbatim from target_node.text, preserving line breaks and notation. Do not add quotation marks, normalize whitespace, or concatenate separate excerpts. Explain additional defects in reason. Identify the exact failed inference and quote current node text.
